name: Malaysia

fees.name: Visa Without Reference (embassy/consulate sticker visa, single/multiple entry)
fees.validity: Typically 3 months to enter; stay per pass issued (usually 30 days)
fees.applies: nationalities not on the published country fee table (default rate); listed countries pay RM6-RM50 per reciprocity table
fees.notes: Immigration Department publishes 'Visa Fee According To The Country' (~35 countries, RM6-RM50). Countries not listed pay RM20.00. Same schedule applies to business/social visit purposes.

fees.name: eVisa (MyVISA portal) processing charge
fees.validity: eVisa valid 3 months, single entry, stay up to 30 days (typical tourist eVisa)
fees.applies: eligible nationalities (e.g., India, China, Bangladesh, Pakistan, Nepal, Sri Lanka, Myanmar)
fees.notes: RM105 processing charge plus the nationality-based visa fee (e.g., RM50 India, RM20 Bangladesh/Nepal) and a payment convenience fee of 0.8%-1.7%. Applied via official MyVISA portal or MVAC centres.

fees.name: Visa On Arrival
fees.applies: India and China nationals arriving from Singapore, Thailand, Indonesia or Brunei with a valid visa of that country
fees.notes: RM200 payable in cash; must show min USD500 funds and confirmed return ticket. Note: India and China citizens are visa-exempt for stays up to 30 days until 31 Dec 2026, so VOA is rarely needed currently.

fees.name: Malaysia Digital Arrival Card (MDAC)
fees.validity: Single arrival; submit within 3 days before entry
fees.notes: Free arrival registration, not a visa. Malaysia has no paid eTA.

fees.name: Business visit visa (Visa Without/With Reference, business purpose)
fees.applies: visa-required nationalities; same nationality-based fee table as tourist visa (default RM20)
fees.notes: Malaysia does not charge a separate business visa fee; the country fee table applies regardless of visit purpose.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.applies: visa-required nationalities leaving the airport; default rate for unlisted countries (listed countries RM20-RM50, e.g., India RM50, China RM30)
fees.notes: Airside transit without leaving the transit area does not require a visa.

reciprocity_variations.note: Single/multiple entry RM50; transit RM50 (imi.gov.my fee table). Visa-exempt for 30-day visits until 31 Dec 2026.
Single/multiple entry RM30 (multiple entry RM30 per imi.gov.my). Visa-exempt for 30-day visits until 31 Dec 2026.
RM6 single/multiple entry, RM20 transit per imi.gov.my table; USA citizens are visa-free for up to 90 days, so rarely applicable.
RM20 single/multiple entry and transit per imi.gov.my table.
RM20 single/multiple entry and transit per imi.gov.my table; eVisa route adds RM105 processing charge.
Not on the published country fee table; default RM20 applies. GBR/PHL/RUS/CAN are visa-exempt for tourism; NGA nationals require a visa (RM20 visa fee + RM105 eVisa processing if applying online).

vfs.operator: MVAC (Malaysia Visa Application Centre / One Stop Centre network)
vfs.note: Since Aug 2022 eVisa applications from India must go via MVAC centres (New Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai); similar outsourced centres exist in several countries. Published centre service fee not verified on an official page; total eVisa cost = visa fee + RM105 processing + centre service charge, varies by centre.

free_visa_notes: Most Western, ASEAN and many other nationalities enter Malaysia visa-free (30-90 days). India and China nationals are visa-exempt for 30-day visits until 31 Dec 2026. The free MDAC digital arrival card is required for nearly all foreign visitors.
